			<h4 style="text-align: center;"><span style="color: #339966;"><b>Blue Dream Kiteboarding Resort</b></span></h4>
<p style="text-align: justify;">The undiscovered refuge of peace surrounded by nature. Experience the last unknown beauty of Costa Rica in privacy, comfort, security and fun. Combine relaxation, food and adrenaline sports as kiteboarding and wing foiling with personalized service. We are located on the north Pacific coast, in the sunny Guanacaste province, 12 kms away from La Cruz, at only 260 mt. away from Papaturro beach, in Bahia Salinas.</p>

</div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><!-- Row Backgrounds --><div class="upb_color" data-bg-override="0" data-bg-color="#efefef" data-fadeout="" data-fadeout-percentage="30" data-parallax-content="" data-parallax-content-sense="30" data-row-effect-mobile-disable="true" data-img-parallax-mobile-disable="true" data-rtl="false"  data-custom-vc-row=""  data-vc="9.0.1"  data-is_old_vc=""  data-theme-support=""   data-overlay="false" data-overlay-color="" data-overlay-pattern="" data-overlay-pattern-opacity="" data-overlay-pattern-size=""    ></div><div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid dt-default" style="margin-top: 0px;margin-bottom: 0px"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-12"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_inner vc_row-fluid"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-6"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper">
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p>A successfully <strong>kiteboarding vacation</strong> is when you go to a place where you have <strong>professional instructors</strong> that take care of you all day, giving lessons, repairing your kites if they brake, renting the best gear in the market as <strong>Duotone, Core and Slingshot</strong> and, the most important, where the wind constantly blows all day and every day almost all year around (especially between the beginning of November and mid May but also from mid June to end of July) with an average of 20/25 knots! There are very few places around the world with such constant wind!! That’s why we are here and we want to share it with you!  We have about 280 guaranteed windy days in an year! Our private entrance to the best spot of the kite beach, the shade, the hammocks, will let you feel the most comfortable you can 🙂</p>
<p><strong>WELCOME DIGITAL NOMADS!</strong> We offer a good internet speed, so you can easily work from your room.</p>
<p><strong>The KITESURFING SCHOOL IS OPEN FROM THE BEGINNING OF NOVEMBER UNTIL THE END OF JULY, but please SEND A MESSAGE by Whatsapp for a previous reservation to Nicola +(506) 88265221 </strong></p>
<p data-reader-unique-id="1"><em><strong>DEAR TURISTS:</strong></em></p>
<p data-reader-unique-id="3"><em>We’d like to inform you that in almost all Costa Rica, there are animals (we guess that one of the reasons you came, it’s for that) but also BUGS. </em></p>
<p data-reader-unique-id="5"><em>That means that no matter if you don’t like them, they are around and they are part of the tropical nature and of course really important for the ecosystem!</em></p>
<p data-reader-unique-id="7"><em>Check in google map: for example, behind us, there is a huge wild area until the biggest dry forest National park of Central America. We can’t and don’t want to build a wall to stop them.</em></p>
		</div>
	</div>

		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p data-reader-unique-id="9"><em>We totally understand that people living in the cities in the northern /southern hemisphere are not used to see them. But please: if you feel uncomfortable to deal with them around (even in the rooms where you’re sleeping), you should choose another country of the world to travel to, ideally away from any country around the Equator where the nature is luckily alive! We don’t like to kill everything is moving even if you want to.</em></p>
<p data-reader-unique-id="11"><em>These are the main insects you may see in our Resort rooms as in any other Hotel even if they are 5 stars:</em></p>
<p data-reader-unique-id="13"><em>Scorpions, spiders, gecos, ants, grasshoppers, crickets.</em></p>
<p data-reader-unique-id="15"><em>None of them is deadly dangerous, so no worries. Feel you are part of the nature as other living being. Consider to be respectful with our hospitality job knowing this situation, many thanks and enjoy the beauty of Costa Rica with us! 🙂</em></p>
